candidates.evidence: Direct NIST page opened; official standards overview and fire-hose interoperability example were available in observed page/search content.

candidates.title: 7 Tips to Keep Your Smart Home Safer and More Private, From a NIST Cybersecurity Researcher

candidates.evidence_scope: identity_verified; candidate content observed in accessible result
candidates.reason: Useful but list format encourages tip extraction more than the evidence-and-output work desired today.

candidates.title: Quantum Computers May Put Internet Traffic at Risk. NIST Is Safeguarding Computers With New Standards.

candidates.evidence_scope: identity_verified; candidate content observed in accessible result
candidates.reason: High quality but too close to the user's technical research interests; selection should not overfit them.

candidates.evidence: Direct page opened; title, educator context, webinar timestamps, map collections and primary-source questions were observed.

candidates.title: Understanding Commodity Prices
candidates.publisher: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis
candidates.evidence: Direct full article opened; title, 2025-12-17 date, author, definitions, supply-demand examples, cocoa pass-through and caveats were observed.
candidates.reason: Strong article, but it returns to economics only nine days after the money-and-trust lesson and offers less topic rotation.

selection_method.selected_rationale: Highest combined quality/usefulness/curiosity/novelty/fit with a directly verifiable official article, a distinct recent topic and a strong classification-to-visualization teaching task.
